# Md Minaruzzaman Shovon — Portfolio & Security Research

> Md Minaruzzaman Shovon is a Full-Stack Developer, WordPress Security Researcher, and Water Resources Engineering student based in Bangladesh.

## Core Profiles & Portfolios
- [Developer Portfolio](https://shovon.bd/dev): Full-stack web engineering with Next.js, TypeScript, UI engineering, and AI product integration.
- [Water Resources Engineering Portfolio](https://shovon.bd/academic): Academic research in hydrology, GIS spatial modeling, and environmental computing at CUET.
- [Security Advisories](https://shovon.bd/security): Responsible vulnerability disclosures and CVE advisories for WordPress plugins.
- [Apps & Software](https://shovon.bd/apps): Web & mobile applications (Attendly Tutor, Mono Alarm, NU Assistant BD, Chalk).
- [Blog](https://shovon.bd/blog): Articles on machine learning, GIS/web mapping, and Android apps ([RSS](https://shovon.bd/blog/rss.xml)).

## Blog Posts
Each post is also available as plain Markdown by appending `.md` to its URL, or by requesting it with `Accept: text/markdown`.
- [I Trained an Open Decision Model on a Free GPU in 46 Minutes. On My Tests, It Beat Laya.](https://shovon.bd/blog/typic-open-decision-model) ([markdown](https://shovon.bd/blog/typic-open-decision-model.md)): Typic (typic-bert), an open 400M decision model returning a probability per option in one forward pass; trained on a free Kaggle T4 in 46 minutes; 69.9% vs Laya's 56.7% on four unseen tasks.
- [The Everyday Attendance Problem for Private Tutors](https://shovon.bd/blog/tutor-attendance-app) ([markdown](https://shovon.bd/blog/tutor-attendance-app.md)): Why attendance tracking is hard for home tutors and what a tutor attendance app needs; introduces the Android app Tuition Tracker: Attendance.
- [How I Built a Real-Time Commute-Time Map for Chittagong Using Next.js, Mapbox & Turf.js](https://shovon.bd/blog/chittagong-commute-time-map) ([markdown](https://shovon.bd/blog/chittagong-commute-time-map.md)): Interactive 10–60 minute driving isochrone map of Chittagong using the Mapbox Isochrone API, Mapbox GL JS and Turf.js. Live at https://maps01.shovon.bd/.

## Disclosed Security Research (CVEs)
- [CVE-2026-15048](https://shovon.bd/security/cve-2026-15048): GeekyBot < 1.2.8 Unauthenticated Sensitive Information Exposure via Chat History session metadata (CVSS 5.3 Medium). Discovered and reported by Md Minaruzzaman Shovon. Patched in 1.2.8.
- [CVE-2026-14322](https://shovon.bd/security/cve-2026-14322): Timetics < 1.0.57 Unauthenticated Booking Auto-Approval via Arbitrary payment_method (CVSS 5.3 Medium). Discovered and reported by Md Minaruzzaman Shovon. Patched in 1.0.57.
- [CVE-2026-10749](https://shovon.bd/security/cve-2026-10749): Post Duplicator <= 3.0.14 PHP Object Injection via unsanitized unserialize() (CVSS 7.2 High). Discovered and reported by Md Minaruzzaman Shovon. Patched in 3.0.15.
- [CVE-2026-57661](https://shovon.bd/security/cve-2026-57661): WPComplete <= 2.9.5.5 Broken Access Control allowing Subscriber-level privilege abuse (CVSS 5.4 Medium). Discovered and reported by Md Minaruzzaman Shovon. Patched in 2.9.5.6.
- [CVE-2026-14821](https://shovon.bd/security/cve-2026-14821): Quiz and Survey Master (QSM) < 11.1.5 Missing Authorization allowing arbitrary output template deletion (CVSS 2.7 Low). Discovered and reported by Md Minaruzzaman Shovon. Patched in 11.1.5.
- [MapPress Maps 2.97.2 Security Assistance](https://wordpress.org/plugins/mappress-google-maps-for-wordpress/#developers): Received official changelog recognition in version 2.97.2 ("Thanks to https://shovon.bd for security assistance in 2.97").
